summary: Release retained original takes the pool master's owner admission that VM delete uses; a needs_attention backup of a member that left the pool settles; orphan re-protection skips a point already gone; a same-ID repository replace over a different destination names the reason and the Controller names a wrong replace_confirmation; test fixture and web regression coverage repaired.

guide.reason: Release retained original is now refused by the pool master while an edit, restore or snapshot operation on the VM is unfinished, and a same-ID replace over a different destination states that reason.

api.reason: vm-release-retained and backup-repository-register keep their routes and bodies. The release now takes the owner admission (delete-check) VM delete takes, so it can fail with the master's 409 reasons, and the register failure text and the Controller's 400 for a wrong replace_confirmation are more specific.

roadmap.reason: Corrections inside the existing backup and restore phase; no gate changes.

state.record: The master's durable pool VM record (pool-vm state) is what the release admission reads; a settled backup run is the master's pool-backup-runs record.
state.reason: No new state. A fresh Controller re-reads the VM record, run history and repository list from the pool master.

verification.method: Focused Go tests in internal/agent and internal/controller (each new regression failed with its fix reverted) and web typecheck and tests. No lab run and no browser walkthrough.
